title: Analyzing User Perceptions of Large Language Models (LLMs) on Reddit: Sentiment and Topic Modeling of ChatGPT and DeepSeek Discussions
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Legal and Ethical Concerns' as one of its three primary themes discovered through topic modeling of Reddit discussions. However, it focuses on analyzing user perceptions and sentiment regarding these issues rather than directly evaluating or benchmarking the religious, moral, or ethical capabilities and frameworks of the LLMs themselves.
